notes: v1.2.0 minor bump: adds 'brand-motion' sub_class containing the Cortexchain vertical brand clip. Typography defect logged at brand_defects[0]; canon decision: standardize on 'CortexChain' (CamelCase) per architect ratification.

brand_defects.defect: Title-card text renders as 'Cortexchain , Inc.' — has a stray space before the comma; also uses all-lowercase 'Cortexchain' instead of the canon CamelCase 'CortexChain'.
brand_defects.canon_decision: Standardize on 'CortexChain, Inc.' (CamelCase, no space before comma). Apply on next render/export. Existing video preserved as-is for provenance.
brand_defects.action_required: On next re-export of brand video, fix title card. No remediation required on existing asset (provenance preserved).

assets.description: Geometric compass/divider line-icon. Two-tone gradient orange/amber outline of a compass inscribed in a circle, transparent background, square aspect.
Heraldic mark: orange/amber crown atop crossed angular elements (feathers or stylized swords), centered on midnight-navy field. Square aspect.
Personal portrait. Subject in fitted patterned hat, oversized dark glasses, gold dental work, plaid collar visible. Hexagonal frame on black background, violet/blue duotone treatment.
Hunt Slonem green rabbit painting in ornate gilt frame. Single black rabbit silhouette over a saturated emerald-green ground, gestural brushwork. Blue-chip contemporary aesthetic reference.
assets.attribution: Hunt Slonem (artist, reference only — not owned)
